summary: Within days of the October 2023 attacks, Antioch Councilmember Torres-Walker called for a ceasefire, condemned colonialism, and declared 'Free Palestine until its backwards.' She then repeatedly pushed the Antioch council to adopt a ceasefire resolution in March 2024, stating she would keep raising it until it reached a regular agenda. CAIR Action endorsed her and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally.
